### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are identified for the Mistral AI finish-reason handling update. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR prevents Semantic Kernel’s Mistral AI chat connector from raising `ValueError` when responses contain finish reasons outside the shared `FinishReason` enum. **Changes:** - Maps `model_length` to `FinishReason.LENGTH` and returns `None` for unknown values, with debug logging. - Uses the mapping for both streaming and non-streaming responses. - Adds parametrized regression tests for both paths, plus a non-streaming check that `length` remains unchanged. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​mistral_ai/​services/​test_mistralai_chat_completion.py` | Adds finish-reason mapping regression tests. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​mistral_ai/​services/​mistral_ai_chat_completion.py` | Centralizes safe finish-reason conversion for both response paths. |
Review effort: Balanced
